purpose: Derive and separately implement the signed independent linear-operator Ward projection from the frozen, non-gauge-fixed GE06+GE07 canonical local row dictionary before attempting any full H4F3d corrected-parent test. Test exact symbolic iso/aniso/shift/source projections and numerical FD4 product differentiation, without asserting source-only Ward zero or full H4 Noether.

operator_contract.frozen_state: w=(N,dr,S,u,phi,T,Sdot,udot,phidot,Tdot) with Cmat shape [16,10], original source rows 6+2
operator_contract.physical_time: d_t=H(x) FD4_x on the same uniform x=ln(a) grid, including d_x(Cmat(x) w(x)) PRODUCT differentiation
operator_contract.ward_operator: -d_t E_shift - (a/3) ik (E_iso+2 E_aniso) = -d_t E_shift-ik a E_L
operator_contract.ward_source: d_t S_shift+(a/3)ik(S_iso+2S_aniso) from H4F3b with separate frozen FD8/FD4 family schemes
operator_contract.full_ward_condition: W_op + W_source + complete signed parent Euler/boundary terms = 0; do not set W_op or W_source individually to zero
operator_contract.spatial: ik=1j*kfund*m, preserve modes 0..40 and original m1..40 science mask
operator_contract.source_sign: E21=L21-S21, no new action normalization or coefficient fit

gates: Exact symbolic reconstruction of E_L and E_R from isotropic/anisotropy Euler rows including pL/pR physical time derivative.
Exact extraction of independent GE06+GE07 shift rows and frozen original Cmat row semantics.
Exact signed W_operator + W_source = W_total after substituting E=L-S, without assuming parent terms vanish.
Original 5-point FD4(x) verified exact for manufactured degree<=4 complex polynomials incl boundaries and H(x)*D_x physical clock.
Realized canonical operator Ward matches independent manufactured analytic polynomial product derivative, including Cmat time dependence, with preregistered relative L2 <=1e-10 and absolute <=1e-10.
Negative controls fail if momentum d_t pL omitted, if d_t Cmat is omitted, or if wrong isotropic-only E_L is used.
No H4F3b source-only magnitude used for a gate, no actual H3F/H3G binaries claimed, no q20 rerun, no H4 Z21 solve.

outcomes.H4F3D1_CANONICAL_OPERATOR_WARD_COMPILER_: The source-bound canonical row/sign and product derivative operator evaluator passes exact symbolic and manufactured numerical tests. It is a necessary H4F3d implementation gate, not the full H4F3d structural PASS.
